fusions.name: Trudging Stamp
fusions.desc: A stamp that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds and has a 25% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 5% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Journey's Weight
fusions.desc: Brings the weight of the road down around you: every enemy within 3.5 tiles is dealt 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and is left [Leaden] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Walking It Off
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds, and your movement speed rises 15% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Paced Miles
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.
